slides.headline: 4) VALUE A STOCK LIKE AN INVESTMENT BANK

Accent: signal blue against slate grey. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. Zero readable text — all screens show only grid cells, chart candles, and $ symbols.

slides.headline: 5) FIND EVERY RISK HIDING IN A STOCK
slides.body: Missing one key risk cost FTX investors $32 billion. This surfaces them all before you buy. "Identify [COMPANY]'s biggest risks: economic, competition, regulation, debt. Rank most to least dangerous."

slides.headline: 6) RUN A BULL VS BEAR DEBATE ON ANY STOCK
slides.body:
Hedge funds pay two analyst teams to argue both sides. You get both for free.

"Run a bull vs bear debate on [TICKER]. Each side uses real data. End with a balanced conclusion."

caption:
Swipe for 6 Gemini prompts that do what a $2,000/month Bloomberg terminal does. Wall Street keeps quiet about these. 🔖

1) Full Wall Street stock analysis,
2) 5-year financial breakdown,
3) competitive moat rating on a 1-10 scale,
4) investment bank valuation with DCF,
5) full risk ranking by severity,
6) bull vs bear debate with data

Bloomberg terminals cost $2,000 a month because data access was the moat. Gemini just removed that moat. Anyone with a phone can now run the same analysis a research desk runs in a day, in under a minute.
